overview: Trade items with another player without the risk of a drop-and-grab. Both sides watch the offer build, and nothing changes hands until both accept.

1.2.0: A trade offer now arrives in the notice tray with Accept and Decline on it. Chat only ever carried one [Accept], so turning an offer down meant ignoring it until it lapsed; now saying no is an answer, and the person who asked is told so.
1.1.1: A trade is no longer turned down for want of room when your bag holds part-full stacks that would have taken the offer anyway.
1.1.0: A trade only starts when both games can actually draw the screen, and accepting now names whose request you are answering. Redrawn icon.
1.0.0: Shift-right-click a player to offer a trade, and a synced screen shows each side's offer as it changes. Items are held in escrow and come back if somebody disconnects, and an operator can push a one-sided server offer at a player through the same screen.
